page: Amazon Web Services m8id.16xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs and 32 physical cores based on the x86_64 Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor running at 3.9 GHz. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 7 GHz, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. For local storage, the instance includes 3800 GB of NVMe SSD instance store volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 30 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core performance, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 21132.0 and a stress-ng multi-core CPU score of 69202.37, both placing in the top tiers. The Intel Xeon processor's advanced vector and matrix extensions, including AVX-512 and AMX, contribute to high-efficiency operations, reflected in strong Passmark CPU extended instructions and encryption test results. Memory performance is highlighted by a read-only cached small block bandwidth of 5110.42 GB/sec and a large block bandwidth of 196.04 GB/sec. Static web serving throughput is exceptionally high at 105.65 GB/sec.

While single-core performance and large-block memory write speeds fall into the average tier, the instance excels in parallel processing and data-intensive tasks. The inclusion of high-capacity local NVMe SSD storage and DDR5 memory provides a balanced, resource-dense profile that is highly cost-efficient for workloads requiring rapid local data access without the overhead of network-attached storage. This makes the m8id.16xlarge well-suited for database operations, software compilation, static web serving, and medium-scale language model prompt processing.
